description: Hierarchical cards on the Svelte 5 data grid board: point board.childrenField at the property holding a row's child rows and each card gains a children count that expands to show its sub-cards inline, the epic to stories shape. Each child shows its own title and status, the parent still moves as one card, and a Board and Table switcher shows the same grid.

faq.question: What shape do the rows need?
faq.answer: Each parent row holds an array of child rows under the field named by childrenField; children use the same title and status fields, and the board reads them for the inline list.

faq.question: Do children move with the parent?
faq.answer: Yes. Children are part of the parent row, so dragging the epic carries its stories; a story's own status is shown on the sub-card but does not place it in a lane.

faq.question: Can I show a progress across children?
faq.answer: The card snippet can count children by status and draw a bar, the way the sub-task checklist does, using the same childrenField data.
